SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_prod_task_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_18') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_18_OLEDBSource_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_prod_task_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_18') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_18_OLEDBSource_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_prod_task_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_18') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_18_OLEDBSource_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_prod_task_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_18') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_18_OLEDBDestination_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_prod_task_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_18') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_18_OLEDBDestination_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_prod_task_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_18') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_18_OLEDBDestination_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Data_Flow_Task_1_180_sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_prod_task_data_import') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_180_sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Data_Flow_Task_1_180_sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_prod_task_data_import') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_180_sink_TableName;

selectquery.defaultValue: SELECT       a.TASK_NUMBER        AS PROD_TASK_NUMBER   , a.SYS_ID             AS PROD_SYS_ID   , a.TASK_NAME          AS PROD_TASK_NAME   , a.RETIREMENT_DATE    AS PROD_RETIREMENT_DATE   , a.REMEDIATION_ACTION AS PROD_REMEDIATION_ACTION   , a.SHORT_DESCRIPTION  AS PROD_SHORT_DESCRIPTION   , a.HARDWARE_PRODUCT   AS PROD_HARDWARE_PRODUCT   , a.STATE_DESCRIPTION  AS PROD_STATE_DESCRIPTION   , a.INSTALL_COUNT      AS PROD_INSTALL_COUNT   , a.SYS_CREATED_ON     AS PROD_SYS_CREATED_ON   , a.SYS_UPDATED_ON     AS PROD_SYS_UPDATED_ON   , a.ASSIGNMENT_GROUP   AS PROD_ASSIGNMENT_GROUP     , b.TASK_NUMBER         AS CHILD_TASK_NUMBER  , b.SYS_ID              AS CHILD_SYS_ID  , b.PARENT              AS CHILD_PARENT  , b.TASK_NAME           AS CHILD_TASK_NAME  , b.RETIREMENT_DATE     AS CHILD_RETIREMENT_DATE  , b.REMEDIATION_ACTION  AS CHILD_REMEDIATION_ACTION  , b.SHORT_DESCRIPTION   AS CHILD_SHORT_DESCRIPTION  , b.HARDWARE_PRODUCT    AS CHILD_HARDWARE_PRODUCT  , b.SOFTWARE_PRODUCT    AS CHILD_SOFTWARE_PRODUCT  , b.STATE_DESCRIPTION   AS CHILD_STATE_DESCRIPTION  , b.INSTALL_COUNT       AS CHILD_INSTALL_COUNT  , b.SYS_CREATED_ON      AS CHILD_SYS_CREATED_ON  , b.SYS_UPDATED_ON      AS CHILD_SYS_UPDATED_ON  , b.ASSIGNMENT_GROUP    AS CHILD_ASSIGNMENT_GROUP     , tsc.WF_GUID           AS TSC_PRODUCT_GUID  , tsc.U_TSC_HARDWARE_MODEL_ID AS TSC_HARDWARE_MODEL_ID  , tsc.WF_GUID AS TSC_MODEL_ID_GUID     , dd.NAME AS DEVICE_NAME  , dd.DEVICE_WF_GUID  , dd.OPERATION_STATUS_DESCRIPTION  , dd.RETIRED_DATE , dd.MANUFACTURER , dd.MODEL_NAME , dd.MODEL_NUMBER    FROM itm_curated.x_g_wfb_product_task a      LEFT JOIN itm_curated.x_g_wfb_product_task b          ON a.SYS_ID = b.PARENT      LEFT JOIN ITM_CURATED.ITMP_HARDWARE_PRODUCT_MODEL tsc          ON a.HARDWARE_PRODUCT = tsc.WF_GUID      LEFT JOIN ITM_CURATED.DEVICE_DIMENSION dd          ON tsc.WF_GUID = dd.MODEL_ID_GUID          AND (b.ASSIGNMENT_GROUP IS NULL OR b.ASSIGNMENT_GROUP = dd.MANAGED_BY_GROUP_GUID)  WHERE a.PARENT IS NULL  AND tsc.U_TSC_HARDWARE_MODEL_ID IN (   '236422166' , '491772929' , '122784027' , '138884865' , '81992000' , '554428478' , '1033818487' , '1033818495' , '1033818538' , '1033818577' , '1033818581' , '1033818593' , '1033818604' , '10413155' , '236418406'   )
